Subject: Temporary burst credits for weekend endurance probe — Hearthly POC

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited. We have one last validation step before we sign: a weekend endurance probe that runs sustained concurrent requests for 36 hours to validate latency tail behavior. Our engineering manager (cc'd) scoped the run and estimates ~220k tokens/day, with spikes up to 2k concurrent tokens per second during soak windows.

We'd like to request a short-term boost of credits (roughly equivalent to a $6k usage allowance) to cover the weekend run and a quick follow-up validation next week. This would be a promotional/top-up request — Hearthly is evaluating Dedicated vs Redwood-hosted, and approval here will help finalize our procurement conversation.

Attached is our usage projection and a short SOW. Can you advise the internal path and timeline for approval? We aim to start the run Friday 12/04 at 20:00 PT.

Thanks,
Samira Khan
VP Product, Hearthly Analytics
Samira@hearthly.ai

Attachments: usage-projection.xlsx, Hearthly_POC_SOW.docx
